R299.note: Fully removes DynamicExpresso evaluation, replacing 'rule' with three hardcoded literal names ('standard'/'premium'/'vip') and canned formulas. The contract requires Evaluate to still return the rule's arithmetic result using orderTotal (i.e. still evaluate a rule expression) with lookupRate restricted to known keys — not replace rule evaluation with fixed business logic. Any real dynamic rule expression a caller previously passed now throws 'Unknown rule', silently, with no caveat.
